title: Delegation follow-up: refuse a worktree whose HEAD is malformed, keeping any Git-valid branch name
outcome: The follow-up owner check refuses a worktree whose administrative HEAD is not a detached object id or a symbolic ref (for example truncated to a fragment of a commit id), while any branch name Git accepts, including Unicode whitespace, still passes; a test covers the malformed-HEAD refusal beside the missing-HEAD case.
acceptance: Delegation follow-up: refuse a worktree whose HEAD is malformed, keeping any Git-valid branch name is done
